correctness.rationale: Recomputed move classes for exactly one vacancy and a,b≥2: same-part moves give ΔΨ=Δu=0; B→A changes x_t by +1 and e_B by +1, giving numerator ΔF=2(dx_t-c(j_t-1))=2cd Δu; A→B gives ΔF=2(cj_t-d(x_t-1))=2cd Δu. Here F=2cdΨ and c=a-1,d=b-1 positive. Integer F strictly increases by even amount under strict utility improvement, so <4(a+b)^3 improving moves. For two types with vacancy in A, B mixed would yield incompatible red and blue inequalities after summing (cd≤c(d-1)); hence B monochromatic, and conversely mover B→A gets utility zero. Count vacancies separately to obtain a(1+z)^{a-1}(1+z^b)+b(1+z)^{b-1}(1+z^a). Independently brute-forced distinct small (a,b,k) states and every legal jump with exact rational recomputation; all checked.
